# CMS pull queue — append a request as the LAST non-comment line, then push.
# The "Pull CMS Content" workflow fetches that object and commits it back [skip ci].
#
# Format:
#   <type> <locale> <handle>     types: post | page | product
#   <locale> <handle>            shorthand → type defaults to post
#
# Examples:
#   post fr creer-maillot-foot-ia-chatgpt-gemini
#   page fr demande-de-design-professionnel-de-maillots
#   product fr the-fracture
#   fr some-blog-handle
#
# (no active line below = nothing to pull)
